functions.name: core_rng_init
functions.brief: Initialize the hardware RNG. Enables the peripheral clock, configures the RNG, and waits for the first random number to be ready. On Core.ST.L4: requires HSI48 to be running (auto-enabled if USB is used, otherwise call ll_rcc_hsi48_enable() first).

functions.name: core_rng_read
functions.brief: Read a single 32-bit random value (blocking). Returns 0 on timeout — check core_rng_error() if this happens.

functions.name: core_rng_fill
functions.brief: Fill a buffer with random 32-bit values (blocking).

params.name: count
params.description: Number of uint32_t values to generate

functions.name: core_rng_error
functions.brief: Check if the RNG has a seed error (entropy source failure).

functions.name: ll_rng_enable
functions.brief: Enable the RNG peripheral with proper clock and conditioning. On STM32WBA55, two things are needed before RNGEN: 1. Select the RNG kernel clock source (HSI16 via RCC_CCIPR2) 2. Perform a conditioning soft reset (CONDRST toggle) Must call ll_rcc_ahb2_clk_enable(LL_AHB2_RNG) before this.

functions.name: ll_rng_data_ready
functions.brief: Check if a random number is ready.

functions.name: ll_rng_read
functions.brief: Read a random 32-bit value (blocking). Returns 0 on timeout or error.

functions.name: ll_rng_fill
functions.brief: Fill a buffer with random 32-bit values (blocking). Returns number of values successfully read.
